latHint: Think a drumbeat inside you, or a symbol on a Valentine.
pivHint: A CHEST is a sturdy box for burying treasure. On your body, it is also the front of your upper body, where the lungs sit beside the ______.
winText: Treasure inside. CHEST was the pivot - a box of gold to the body part that beats inside it, the HEART.
lossText: HEART - the organ that pumps blood. CHEST was the pivot: a treasure CHEST is a sturdy box, but your CHEST is also the front of your upper body, which holds your lungs and your HEART.
